tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Shipshape Data's documentation: 205 practical guides on data and AI plus the service and industry pages. Results include the questions each page answers and its URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown twin of any shipshapedata.com page (articles, services, industries, case studies). Pass the page URL or path, e.g. "/resources/data-architecture/data-cleaning/".

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: The site's sections and resource categories with article counts, for orientation before searching. Pass a category name to list every guide in it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Shipshape Data's documentation: 203 practical guides on data and AI plus the service and industry pages. Results include the questions each page answers and its URL." → after: "Search Shipshape Data's documentation: 205 practical guides on data and AI plus the service and industry pages. Results include the questions each page answers and its URL."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
